title: Grateful Dead Live at Iowa Fieldhouse - University of Iowa on 1982-08-10
lineage: DAT > WAV (via TB Fiji S/PDIF) > SHN
source: SBD > Master Cassette > DAT > Digidesign/Audio Media > DAT

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with some sound problems but a mind‑blowing, high‑energy show featuring a rare double encore.
ai_review.review: The reviewer describes the concert as unforgettable – the crowd even piled chairs and danced, culminating in a double encore. Although the tape suffers from noticeable sound issues, the performance shines through and remains a standout memory for the fan.

ai_rating.rationale: Single review gives a solid 4‑star rating; praises the show’s energy and uniqueness while noting recording flaws, leading to an overall high‑ish score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer mentions "sound problems" with the tape despite it being a soundboard source; overall usable but not pristine.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Crowd got increasingly into the music, chairs piled up on the edge and dancing erupted, finishing with a rare double encore – a very high‑energy flow.
